metaDescription: Kevin warns that biometrics will soon be required for everything and that the data will be used to train AI models on people, with no public vote.
summary: Kevin warns that biometric identification is coming and that people will use it to get into everything they do. He argues this removes the excuse that someone else was driving a car or using a phone, and that the purpose goes beyond tracking: he says AI models are being trained on the resulting data. Kevin adds that the public will never get a vote on this.
